Packaging checklist (high level):
- Build single PDF: cover page (procurement-specific), TOC/bookmarks, section dividers per control family.
- Redaction: use transparent overlay for PII and "REDACTED" text where necessary; keep a separate copy of originals in S3.
- Watermark: "For Procurement — Embargoed" on every page except cover. Center faint footer watermark, do not obstruct text.
- Fonts: embed all fonts; flatten forms; ensure OCR layer included (where feasible) for search.
- File metadata: strip author fields but include a manifest row with original timestamps.
- PDF security: do NOT password-protect the PDF (procurement team wants easy preview in Whistic), but add a visible access note on the cover.
- Naming convention: REDWOOD_SIG_20261105_procurement.pdf

I will attach packaging-checklist-20261105.md to the bundle. Draft PDF should be ready in ~3 hours for internal review.

-M
